name: 配对 live 与个人使用审计前置检查
stage_task: Run at least three new fixed-versus-Planner paired paper-discovery task units.
Audit at least five real task units across paper_discovery and evidence_question_answering.
Preserve independent raw requests, responses, failures, budgets, citations and recovery evidence.
Record at least one user-confirmed use of a delivery without treating CLI execution as Workbench acceptance.
expected_functionality: A user can select a bounded strategy for an admitted paper-discovery candidate.
Fixed and bounded strategies can execute comparable live tasks with visible strategy, status, citations, limitations and recovery state.
The system preserves no-answer and partial semantics without retry, fallback or constraint relaxation.
Personal-use evidence remains separate from mechanism tests and offline evaluation.

acceptance_gates.required: W4.5 admits C after C beats B in at least 2/3 frozen cases.
acceptance_gates.actual: W4.5 rejected C after improvement in only 1/3 cases.

acceptance_gates.required: Freeze new cases, Provider/model, Prompt, budget, network, exact inputs, blind review and stop conditions.
acceptance_gates.actual: Not frozen because the blocking candidate gate failed first.

acceptance_gates.required: Execute isolated A/C Runs and retain raw evidence without retry or fallback.
At least five real task units across two families and one user-confirmed use.

decision.reason: Paired live validation cannot validly admit a strategy that failed the frozen offline candidate gate.

recovery_paths.description: Keep fixed-arxiv-v1 as the W4 outcome and do not spend live budget on rejected C.
Define a materially revised C with a new hypothesis and freeze, then repeat offline W4.5 before any W4.6 live run.

prohibited_shortcut: A live diagnostic spike for rejected C, if separately approved later, cannot count as original W4.6 admission evidence or override the 2/3 gate.
evidence_boundary: This preflight proves only that W4.6 cannot proceed under the frozen protocol after W4.5 rejection. It does not test live Provider, arXiv, Planner quality or personal use.
